jobs.occupation: Technical Sales & Product Manager (m/w/d) (Fachberater/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description: About UsVirtue Intelligence GmbH is an internationally operating technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, Germany. We specialize in electronic components, semiconductors, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, industrial networking, and embedded systems.By combining international sourcing capabilities, technical expertise, and strong partnerships with manufacturers and development teams, we provide electronic components and customized technology solutions to customers across Germany and Europe.To support our continued business expansion, we are seeking an experienced and results-driven Technical Sales & Business Development Manager.The primary focus of this role is to develop our electronic components and semiconductor business, while actively expanding our customer base and identifying new opportunities in IoT solutions and industrial networking products.Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Business Development- Identify and acquire new customers across Germany and Europe, particularly OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, system integrators, and industrial manufacturers.- Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships and strategic accounts.- Drive sales of electronic components, including semiconductors, integrated circuits (ICs), active and passive components, connectors, and related products.- Actively develop new customers and business opportunities for IoT devices, embedded systems, and industrial networking solutions.- Promote industrial Ethernet switches, industrial routers, 4G/5G communication devices, asset trackers, sensors, and customized hardware solutions.- Identify potential customers in industrial automation, logistics, telecommunications, smart infrastructure, and other relevant industries.- Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer inquiries to quotations, negotiations, and contract closure.- Achieve agreed revenue, gross margin, and business development targets.2. Electronic Components Sales & Customer Support- Manage customer inquiries, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), and component sourcing requirements.- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.- Support customers in sourcing hard-to-find, shortage, and end-of-life (EOL) components.- Identify design-in opportunities and provide technical and commercial support during component selection.- Collaborate with international manufacturers, distributors, and supply partners.- Identify cross-selling opportunities and expand business with existing customers.- Support customers throughout the entire purchasing process, from initial inquiry to successful delivery.3. Product Management & Technical Solutions- Support the management and development of selected product portfolios, including electronic components, IoT devices, and industrial networking products.- Identify new products and technologies based on customer requirements, market trends, and business opportunities.- Evaluate manufacturer and partner solutions regarding technical suitability, commercial competitiveness, and market potential.- Support technical discussions, product selection, design-in activities, and customized hardware development.- Define product requirements in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, and development partners.- Contribute to product roadmaps, business cases, pricing strategies, and go-to-market activities.- Support new product introductions and product lifecycle management.4. International Supplier & Project Coordination- Establish and maintain relationships with international manufacturers, distributors, and technology partners.- Coordinate product specifications, pricing, availability, delivery schedules, and technical requirements.- Act as an interface between customers, suppliers, engineering teams, purchasing, and logistics.- Support customer-specific development projects and technical evaluations.- Coordinate IoT and industrial networking projects from initial requirements through product delivery.- Assist in resolving technical, quality-related, and supply chain issues.5. Market Analysis & Strategic Business Development- Monitor market trends, technology developments, pricing, and competitive activities in the electronics industry.- Identify emerging opportunities in electronic components, IoT, and industrial communication markets.- Explore potential new product categories, suppliers, and strategic partnerships.- Develop sales strategies and support go-to-market plans for new products and solutions.- Represent Virtue Intelligence at trade fairs, industry exhibitions, and customer events.- Maintain accurate customer information, sales opportunities, and project records in CRM systems.- Prepare regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and business development reports.Qualifications & RequirementsProfessional Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least three years of professional experience in electronic component sales, semiconductor distribution, technical sales, or business development.- Proven experience in new customer acquisition and B2B relationship development.- Solid knowledge of electronic components, semiconductors, and the electronics supply chain.- Experience working with OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, electronics manufacturers, or industrial customers.- Familiarity with RFQs, BOM analysis, component sourcing, pricing negotiations, and customer project management.- An established customer network within the German or European electronics industry is highly desirable.- Experience working with electronic component distributors, semiconductor manufacturers, or international technology partners is an advantage.Additional Technical Expertise – Preferred- Knowledge of IoT technologies, embedded systems, or industrial networking.- Familiarity with industrial Ethernet switches, routers, and industrial communication solutions.- Understanding of wireless and cellular technologies, including 4G, 5G, LTE-M, and NB-IoT.- Experience with IoT devices, asset tracking, sensors, or wireless communication modules.- Experience in technical product management, design-in projects, or customized electronic solutions.Experience in IoT and industrial networking is considered a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Proven electronic component sales experience and customer development capabilities remain the primary selection criteria.Personal Skills- Strong sales orientation, commercial awareness, and negotiation skills.- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and results-driven approach.- Ability to work independently and manage multiple customers and projects.- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.- Customer-focused attitude and willingness to develop long-term business partnerships.- Ability to collaborate effectively with international customers, suppliers, and engineering teams.- Willingness to travel for customer meetings, trade shows, and occasional international business trips.Language Requirements- German: Native-level proficiency, both written and spoken.- English: Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.- Additional Languages: Proficiency in other European languages is considered a strong advantage.- Chinese language skills are an advantage but not mandatory.What We Offer- A challenging and rewarding role combining technical sales, business development, and product management.- The opportunity to expand our electronic components business and develop new markets for IoT and industrial networking solutions.- An international business environment with access to manufacturers, suppliers, and technology partners.- Direct collaboration with company management and short decision-making processes.- A high degree of autonomy and the opportunity to shape new business activities.- Flexible working arrangements and remote work options by agreement.- Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, subject to agreement.- Long-term professional development opportunities and potential for expanded responsibilities.How to ApplyAre you an experienced sales professional in the electronics industry with strong customer relationships and a passion for developing new business opportunities? Would you like to combine your expertise in electronic components with innovative IoT and industrial networking technologies? Join Virtue Intelligence GmbH and help us expand our business across Germany and Europe.Please submit your CV, earliest possible starting date, and salary expectations to:Virtue Intelligence GmbHDarmstadt, GermanyEmail: web@virtue-intelligence.deWebsite: https://virtue-intelligence.com/Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktmanagement, Reklamationsbearbeitung, E-Commerce, E-BusinessExpertenkenntnisse: Pre-Sales-ServiceZwingend erforderlich: Präsentation, Außendienst, Vertrieb

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.
